faqs.a:
Regular and probationary non-exempt employees assigned to be on-call for a set period
               and required to be available to respond to emergency situations on a 24-hour a day
               basis will be paid on-call pay in accordance with applicable federal and state laws
               and a policy established by the city manager.
(
Ord. No. 4862
, § 1, 10-16-2023;
Ord. No. 4890
, § 7, 2-10-2025)
